settings.title: Settings
settings.usage_analytics_tooltip: Collects anonymous usage data to help improve the app

phrase.warning: Anyone who knows your Recovery Phrase can access your wallet and all funds.
phrase.rule_share: Never share your Recovery Phrase with anyone.
phrase.rule_ask: MEW will never ask you for your Recovery Phrase.
phrase.rule_offline: Write it down and keep it offline.
phrase.next_step: You'll log in again on a separate page, where you can copy it.

export_page.title: Recovery Phrase
export_page.intro: Log in again to copy your Recovery Phrase. Privy hands it over on its own secure screen, and MEW never sees it. Anyone who has it can take your funds.
export_page.showing: Privy's window lets you copy your Recovery Phrase or your private key. Paste it only somewhere safe and offline, then close the window.
export_page.done_title: You're logged out of this page
export_page.done_body: If you copied your Recovery Phrase, it is still on your clipboard. Paste it somewhere safe and offline first, then clear the clipboard.
export_page.clipboard_cleared: Clipboard cleared. You can close this tab.
export_page.clipboard_failed: We couldn't clear the clipboard. To replace what is on it, copy something else.
export_page.error: We couldn't get your Recovery Phrase. Please try again.

settings.remove_last_passkey: This is your only passkey. Removing it turns off the passkey check for your wallet.
settings.passkey_not_active: A passkey is not protecting your wallet yet.
settings.passkey_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
settings.currency_description: Choose the currency used to display prices and balances across the app.
settings.fee_description: This fee is charged by the Ethereum network and fluctuates depending on network traffic. MEW does not profit from this fee.
